items.question: What services does Ecommetrix provide?
items.answer: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, video and creative production, website design and development, graphics design, email marketing, content support, and server-side and conversion tracking.

items.question: Do you work with international businesses?
items.answer: Yes. We are based in Dhaka and work with businesses in Bangladesh and abroad.

items.question: Can we hire individual services?
items.answer: Yes. You can start with one service, such as Meta Ads or tracking, and add more when you need them.

items.question: Do you provide video production?
items.answer: Yes. Our team handles concept, script, shoot and edit, and delivers cuts for each ad placement.

items.question: Do you provide server-side tracking?
items.answer: Yes. We set up Meta Pixel with Conversions API, server-side Google Tag Manager, GA4 and ecommerce events, with deduplication.

items.question: How does onboarding work?
items.answer: We follow our four-step framework: a discovery call, a written strategy, launch, then ongoing optimization and reporting.

items.question: How can we start working together?
items.answer: Send us a message on WhatsApp or by email, or use the contact form. We will set up a short call to understand your goals.
